nodes.label: Tab Icon: Home - 1x/2x/3x density variants
nodes.description: Small black silhouette tab navigation icon for the Home tab. Available in three densities: home.png (24x24), home@2x.png (48x48), home@3x.png (72x72). Black/dark opaque content on transparent background. Used in bottom tab bar navigation.

edges.note: Both are bottom tab bar navigation icons in the same tabIcons directory
